name: iam_action_exact_wildcard_allow
reason: IAM policy statement with Action="*" and Effect="Allow" (Rule A)

name: iam_action_wildcard_in_list_allow
reason: IAM policy statement with Action list containing "*" and Effect="Allow" (Rule A)

name: iam_action_wildcard_deny
reason: Action="*" but Effect="Deny" (not Allow) - vendor rule requires Allow

name: iam_service_prefix_wildcard_allow
reason: Action="s3:*" (service-scoped) is NOT the exact wildcard "*" that Rule A matches [reconciled: vendor deny-rule B: Resource==* & Allow & Action contains *]

name: iam_action_semicolon_syntax
reason: Action="*" with Effect="Allow" using colon syntax (case-insensitive regex matches)

name: iam_no_effect
reason: Action="*" but no Effect specified - vendor rule requires Effect="Allow"

name: iam_resource_wildcard_action_wildcard_allow
reason: Resource="*" and Effect="Allow" and Action="*" contains wildcard (Rule B)

name: iam_resource_wildcard_action_service_wildcard_allow
reason: Resource="*" and Effect="Allow" and Action="s3:*" contains wildcard (Rule B)

name: iam_resource_wildcard_action_list_with_wildcard_allow
reason: Resource="*" and Effect="Allow" and Action list contains "ec2:*" with wildcard (Rule B)

name: iam_resource_wildcard_no_wildcard_action_allow
reason: Resource="*" and Effect="Allow" but NO wildcard in Action list (no * in any action)

name: iam_resource_scoped_wildcard_action_allow
reason: Action="s3:*" contains wildcard but Resource is NOT "*" (Rule B requires Resource="*")

name: iam_resource_wildcard_wildcard_action_deny
reason: Resource="*" and Action="s3:*" but Effect="Deny" (not Allow) - Rule B requires Allow

name: sg_rule_ingress_public_ssh_exact
input:
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "ssh" {
  type            = "ingress"
  from_port       = 22
  to_port         = 22
  protocol        = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks     = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  security_group_id = "sg-12345"
}
reason: Ingress rule with type="ingress", cidr=0.0.0.0/0, from_port=22, to_port=22 covers port 22
